SELECT COALESCE(SITE, '<SQL NULL>') AS site_value,
       DATE_TRUNC('week', EVENT_TS)::DATE AS week_start,
       COUNT(*) AS events,
       COUNT(DISTINCT PATIENT_ID) AS patients,
       COUNT(DISTINCT EVENT_NAME) AS distinct_event_names,
       MAX(EVENT_SOURCE) AS sample_source
FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.FACT_EVENTS
WHERE EVENT_TS >= '2026-06-01'
  AND (SITE IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(SITE)) IN ('null', 'undefined', ''))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2, 1

SELECT PRODUCT,
       COUNT(*) AS events,
       COUNT(DISTINCT PATIENT_ID) AS patients,
       SUM(CASE WHEN PATIENT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS events_without_patient,
       MIN(EVENT_TS)::DATE AS first_seen,
       MAX(EVENT_TS)::DATE AS last_seen
FROM ANALYTICS.DWH.FACT_EVENTS
WHERE EVENT_TS >= DATEADD('day', -14, CURRENT_DATE)
  AND SITE IS NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
